source: tccli lighthouse DescribeInstances and tat RunCommand / DescribeInvocationTasks
scope: Read-only metadata and short host capacity sample; no deployment, account creation or database write
redaction: Instance IDs, public IPs, other project container names and raw server output omitted
limits: A short sample cannot establish sustained capacity or four-user performance
Full swap occupancy does not by itself prove ongoing swap pressure
The first vmstat row is a since-boot average; only subsequent rows are interval samples
DNS and TLS setup remain unverified
Existing MySQL belongs to another project; GeekDash will use its own instance
